scope: Native nonempty dictionary construction and VM duplicate-key/error semantics. Native owned argument entry and non-immediate constant loading are not widened.
changes: Duplicate constant keys use the ordered map bytecode path, evaluate all values, and retain the last entry.
Dynamic and unique fixed-key constructors marshal tagged operands and release consumed roots.
JIT compiler retains fixed-key Arc allocations for native-code lifetime; helper clones ownership from the correct Vec allocation pointer.
Construction helpers reuse VM nesting checks; dynamic-key validation preserves VM string-only contract.
VM invalid literal-key errors now honor exception handlers without replaying effects.
